- [ ] `N1980-CD-1702-80` 1980-10-13 · Prot. - [ ] `N1978-138-p57-1` ????-??-?? · no protocol · Response to a dubium (Dubia section, no protocol or date printed) ruling that where particular calendars assign the celebration of the B.V.M. Queen of Apostles to the Saturday after the Ascension, it is kept on the Saturday after the Sixth Sunday of Easter where the Ascension is on Thursday, and on the Saturday after the Seventh Sunday of Easter where the Ascension is transferred to that Sunday. Recorded as kind other because it is an interpretative response affecting the date of a celebration in particular calendars, not a decree; the page prints no page number (52 taken from the table of contents). ([Notitiae 1978 p. 52](https://www.cultodivino.va/content/dam/cultodivino/rivista-notitiae/1970/notitiae-14-(1978)/Notitiae-138-1978.pdf#page=57)) ⚠ needs review
